remediated_findings.summary: Write-path prompt injection prevention in record_feedback()
remediated_findings.resolution: Pre-persistence prompt injection detection in record_feedback() returning explicit Rejected status; zero artifacts written to rules.jsonl

remediated_findings.summary: Feedback slot collision between preference and repeated_context
remediated_findings.resolution: Assigned distinct slots for all 4 feedback types (acknowledge-and-correct-immediately, honor-user-preferences, remember-stated-context, complete-all-parts-of-request); added idempotent legacy rule migration

remediated_findings.summary: Detector recall on paraphrased prompt injection attacks
remediated_findings.resolution: Expanded regex pattern set and weighted signal model covering directive nullification, mode switches, restriction removal, exfiltration, and safety overrides; 100% recall with 0% false positives on benign developer prompts

remediated_findings.summary: Deterministic regex bounded recall and two-stage pipeline requirement
remediated_findings.resolution: Introduced two-stage detection pipeline: Stage 1 deterministic regex/weighted signal + Stage 2 semantic intent classifier with graceful fallback

remediated_findings.summary: PII markers present in local rule hint before persistence and telemetry sharing
remediated_findings.resolution: Implemented scrub_pii() covering 5+ categories (emails, user home paths, system paths, IPv4/IPv6, phone, API tokens); executed client-side pre-persistence and server-side at relay boundary

remediated_findings.summary: fetch_community_patterns() gated on HF_TOKEN despite public dataset readability
remediated_findings.resolution: Removed token gating from read path; decoupled from huggingface_hub; implemented fallback chain (CDN -> cache -> bundled_rules)

remediated_findings.summary: Immediate unvetted publication to public repository vulnerable to rule poisoning
remediated_findings.resolution: Migrated from public HF publishing to Cloudflare Worker relay + private R2 bucket + scheduled aggregator with k-anonymity (min_sources >= 5) and content filtering
